chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Al-Halbi, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Have you visited the Mosque of Quba, or the Mosque of Al-Fadikh, or the drinking place of Umm Ibrahim?' I said, 'Yes'. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, no trace of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) remains, except that it has been changed, apart from this.'

key_terms.مَسْجِدَ الْفَضِيخِ: Mosque of Al-Fadikh, another historical site in Medina
key_terms.مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءَ: Mosque of Quba, a prominent mosque in Medina associated with the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about the traces of the Prophet in places like Masjid Quba?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) uses the example of Masjid Quba and the drinking place of Umm Ibrahim to illustrate that while the physical traces of the Prophet (saww) have been altered or lost, the spiritual merit of visiting these sites remains intact. This hadith, found in *Al-Kafi*, underscores the Shia emphasis on *ziyarat* (visitation) not merely as a preservation of history, but as a means of connecting with the legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophet, even when the original physical markers have changed. It serves as a theological foundation for the veneration of shrines, affirming that the sanctity of a place is not solely dependent on the unaltered preservation of its original state.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ibn Muskaan, from Al Halby who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Have you ever gone to Masjid Quba, or Masjid Al-Fazeekh, or the drinking place of Umm Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>?’ I said, ‘Yes’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, there does not remain any traces of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> of anything, except that they have changed it, apart from this’.
en.sarwar: 5. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from ibn Muskan from al-Halabiy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once asked, ‘Have you gone to Masjid of Quba’, or Masjid of al- Fadikh, or Mashrabah of mother of Ibrahim?’ I replied, ‘Yes, I have done so.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No other thing of the things reminding of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, is left that is not changed except this.’”
